case.short_input: Data analyst resume vs Frontend Intern JD
case.expected: Low score; most frontend skills listed as missing

analysis.score_reason: The candidate's profile is heavily focused on Data Analytics and lacks the core Frontend Engineering stack (React, JavaScript, TypeScript) required for the role.

missing_skills.jd_evidence: Experience with TypeScript in a real project
Exposure to unit testing with Jest or a similar framework

weak_bullet_ids.original: Analysed 3 years of campus placement data (4,200 records) in Python and pandas, and published a Tableau dashboard used by the placement cell.
Built a churn prediction model in scikit-learn reaching 0.81 ROC-AUC on a public telecom dataset.
Wrote 40+ SQL queries against a PostgreSQL warehouse to build weekly sales reports.
Automated a manual Excel report in Python, saving roughly 6 hours per week.

red_flags: Zero overlap between candidate's technical stack (Data Science/Analytics) and the job requirements (Frontend Engineering).
No evidence of web development projects or experience.

rewrites.original: Analysed 3 years of campus placement data (4,200 records) in Python and pandas, and published a Tableau dashboard used by the placement cell.
rewrites.improved: Visualized 4,200 records of campus placement data by designing and publishing an interactive Tableau dashboard for the university placement cell.
rewrites.why_better: Focuses on the data visualization and dashboard design aspect, which is more relevant to frontend UI/UX presentation than data analysis.

rewrites.original: Built a churn prediction model in scikit-learn reaching 0.81 ROC-AUC on a public telecom dataset.
rewrites.improved: Engineered a data-driven model using scikit-learn to process telecom datasets, achieving a 0.81 ROC-AUC score.
rewrites.why_better: Reframes the technical implementation to emphasize engineering logic and model performance, which demonstrates analytical rigor useful for frontend data handling.

rewrites.original: Wrote 40+ SQL queries against a PostgreSQL warehouse to build weekly sales reports.
rewrites.improved: Developed 40+ complex SQL queries to extract and structure data from PostgreSQL, facilitating the generation of weekly sales reports.
rewrites.why_better: Highlights the ability to interface with backend databases, a critical skill for frontend engineers working with API-driven data.

rewrites.original: Automated a manual Excel report in Python, saving roughly 6 hours per week.
rewrites.improved: Automated manual reporting workflows using Python, streamlining data processing and saving 6 hours of manual effort per week.
rewrites.why_better: Emphasizes process automation and efficiency, demonstrating the ability to build tools that improve operational workflows.
